ui.about_tag: Ko te wāhi e āhua ai te rangi.
ui.about_lead: He mapi āhuatanga rangi ao-here-kore e whiwhi manawa ora ana i te tono. Kua pokaia ngā āhuatanga rangi māori o te ao whānui, ka pānuihia i te ao-here-kore; ka tikina anake ngā āhuatanga o nāianei, ngā matapae, ngā whakatūpato me ngā papa raster ina tonoa e koe.

ui.about_privacy: Ka noho tō pine kāinga me tō kī OpenWeatherMap ki tēnei pūtirotiro anake, kāore rawa e tukuna ki tētahi atu wāhi. Ka tīmata te taupānga me te kore ao-here, ka whakapā anake mō ngā raraunga ora e tonoa ana e koe, mā te tuku noa i ngā ahunga e tika ana.
ui.about_foot: Weatherglass — he kore utu, he ao-here-kore tōmua. Ka whakaatu ia pānuitanga i tōna wā; i te ao-here-kore, ka mau tonu ngā āhuatanga māori kua pokaia.

ui.disc_title: I mua i tō whakawhirinaki ki a Weatherglass
ui.disc_body:
He taputapu pārongo a Weatherglass, ehara i te ratonga haumaru. Ka tikina mai ngā raraunga rangi, ngā matapae, ngā raupapa hītori me ngā whakatūpato mana mai i ngā pūtake tuatoru (Open-Meteo, MET Norway, te US National Weather Service, ngā tari haumeteorarangi ā-motu, GDACS, me OpenWeatherMap ina tāpirihia e koe tō ake kī). Ka taea te whakaroa, te kore oti, te hē, te kore wātea rānei, ā, ka taea e Weatherglass te pānui hē, te kore whakaatu rānei i aua raraunga.

Kaua e whakamahia tēnei taupānga hei whakatau take e whai pānga ana ki te ora, te hauora, te taonga, te haumaru haerenga rānei — tae atu ki ngā āwhā, ngā waipuke, ngā rererangi, te rere kaipuke, te hīkoi maunga, te mahi ā-waho rānei. Whaia tonutia ō mana whenua haumeteorarangi ā-rohe me ngā tohutohu tiaki ā-iwi; ka nui ake te mana o ā rātou whakatūpato i tērā o tēnei taupānga.

Ka whakaatu te mapi āhuatanga rangi ao-here-kore i ngā toharite roa (1991–2020) me ngā pūkete hītori. Ka whakaahuahia ngā āhuatanga māori, ehara i te aha rā te rangi i tētahi rā motuhake.

Ka whakamahia te wāhi ina pāwhiri koe ki te whakamahi, mō te tiki rangi anake mō taua ira, ā, kāore mātou e pupuri i tēnei raraunga i ngā wā katoa. Ka mau tō pine kāinga me ō tautuhinga ki tēnei pūrere anake.

Ka tukuna kore utu a Weatherglass, “pēnei tonu”, kāore he taunakitanga o tētahi āhua. Kia tino nui ana e whakaaetia ana e te ture, kāore te kaituhi e whai kawenga mō tētahi ngaronga, kino rānei ka puta i te whakamahinga, i te whakawhirinaki rānei ki ōna kai i roto.

Mā te pāwhiri i Kua mārama ahau, ā, e whakaae ana ka whakaūhia e koe kua pānuihia e koe tēnei pānui. Ka whakaaturia anō i muri i ia whakahōu.
